note: Captured two reusable candidates from the story issue and review finding.

candidates.text: When an integration supports both webhooks and polling, default to the transport that works in local/dev without public infrastructure and enable webhook mode only when deployment settings clearly support it.
candidates.rationale: Story-004 had to be reframed mid-stream because webhook-first assumptions made development and testing harder than necessary; the successful path was long polling by default with webhook as an optional upgrade.

candidates.text: When runtime config accepts an external webhook URL, validate that the application actually serves the same webhook path or derive the served route from that URL before enabling webhook mode.
candidates.rationale: The completion review found that accepting an arbitrary webhook URL path can silently point the provider at an unserved route; this is a reusable configuration-safety rule for webhook integrations.
